description: BadgerCare Plus is full coverage Wisconsin Medicaid for eligible people ages 0–64. You can apply at any time through ACCESS, with county or Tribal agency assistance available.
introduction: BadgerCare Plus is full coverage Wisconsin Medicaid for eligible people ages 0–64. You can apply at any time through ACCESS, with county or Tribal agency assistance available.

who: Wisconsin residents ages 0–64 meeting the relevant category and income rules.
Income limits differ for adults, pregnant people and children; a screening is not a final determination.
Older, blind or disabled applicants may need the separate Medicaid application route.
sections.get: Approved medical coverage and a ForwardHealth card. Confirm providers and any health plan arrangements before receiving non-emergency care.
sections.docs: Prepare applicant identity and status, household composition, job and other income and available employer insurance. The agency’s verification request identifies needed records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply online through ACCESS, or telephone or visit the county or Tribal agency.
  2. For mail filing use the BadgerCare Plus packet listed on ForwardHealth’s application page.
  3. Supply requested verification and read the coverage decision.
sections.after: Use ACCESS or MyACCESS to manage the case and follow renewal instructions. Ask the local agency about children’s premiums if applicable. A federal work requirement listed for 2027 is a future change; follow current notices about its implementation.

faqs: Must I wait for open enrollment?
No; BadgerCare Plus applications are accepted at any time.
Are adult and child income limits identical?
No; consult the current category table or apply for assessment.
What card do approved members receive?
Ask about Medicaid for elderly, blind or disabled applicants and its separate packet.
Where do I manage an approved case?
Use ACCESS or the MyACCESS mobile app.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
